experiment.research_question: Under the same demonstration budget and training recipe, does shared-autonomy-assisted data collection improve closed-loop policy success over manual data collection?

task.instruction: Pick up the red cube and place it in the UP region.

success_requires_all: The gripper establishes a grasp across two opposing faces of the red cube; a grasp on an edge is not a successful grasp.
The policy lifts the red cube clear of its initial support surface.
The policy releases the red cube in the UP target region, where it remains at the end of the rollout.
The rollout is not terminated by a safety abort.
not_required_for_success: The gripper yaw matches the intended sign or angle exactly.
The grasp is centered or visually perfect, provided that the gripper contacts two opposing faces rather than an edge.
The motion path is perfectly smooth.
failure_examples: The gripper does not reach a graspable position.
The gripper grasps on an edge, even if the cube is subsequently lifted or placed in the target region.
The cube is contacted or grasped but is not lifted clear of the support surface.
The cube slips or is dropped before placement.
The cube is released outside the UP target region or does not remain there at the end of the rollout.
The rollout times out, remains incomplete, or is terminated by a safety abort.
primary_metric.adjudication: Human observation supported by rollout video/replay notes.
primary_metric.quality_note: Yaw-sign errors, under-rotation, over-rotation, XY offsets, and other non-fatal execution imperfections remain quality annotations. Edge grasp is a hard failure, not a quality-only annotation.

evaluation_protocol.conditions: 9 categorical XY positions x 4 wrap90 yaw values
evaluation_protocol.pairing: Both policies were evaluated on the same physical arrangement for each condition.
evaluation_protocol.scope_limit: This protocol does not establish performance over arbitrary continuous XY positions or arbitrary yaw angles.

shared_autonomy.assistance: Human controls XYZ and gripper; the yaw assistant controls J6 alignment.

condition_grid.matrix_semantics: Rows follow task.initial_pose_grid.position_ids; columns follow task.initial_pose_grid.yaw_deg_wrap90. true means hard_success.

failure_type_definitions.edge_grasp: The gripper grasps on an edge rather than across two opposing faces. This remains the primary failure type even if the cube is lifted or placed afterward.
failure_type_definitions.no_grasp: The rollout never establishes an effective grasp on the cube.
failure_type_definitions.no_lift: The gripper contacts or holds the cube but does not lift it clear of the support surface.
failure_type_definitions.grasp_slip_or_drop: The grasp loses the cube through slipping or dropping before target placement is completed; the field note does not need to establish that a clear lift occurred first.
failure_type_definitions.placement_outside_target: The cube is released outside the UP region or does not remain in the region at rollout end.
failure_type_definitions.timeout_or_incomplete: The rollout reaches its time or step limit without completing the task.
failure_type_definitions.safety_abort: The rollout is terminated by a safety gate, emergency stop, or other safety intervention.
failure_type_definitions.other: The failure does not fit another type and must be explained in the note.

classification_rules: primary_failure_type is null when hard_success is true and contains exactly one value when hard_success is false.
quality_flags may contain zero or more values for either successful or failed rollouts.
edge_grasp is always a hard failure and must not be represented only as a quality flag.
public_record_schema.quality_flags_serialization: Zero or more enum values separated by |; an empty field means no quality flag.
public_record_schema.notes_status: All 36 normalized English records were audited against the private XLSX field notes. Success labels, numeric observations, spatial directions, edge grasps, and slip events match the source; no machine identity, absolute path, person name, or exact site coordinate is included.

provenance.source_evidence_status: Evaluation labels and dataset counts were verified against private source records; private paths are intentionally not published.
